stages.effectText: Attacks deal Arts damage and jump between 4 enemies. Each jump deals 10% less damage and inflicts a short Slow
When there are no enemies in the surrounding 4 tiles, ATK +8% and own SP recovery rate +0.15/second
When there are no enemies in the surrounding 4 tiles, ATK +8% and own SP recovery rate +0.25/second
Attacks deal Arts damage and jump between 4 enemies. Each jump no longer deals less damage and inflicts a brief Slow
When attacking enemies with 80% or more HP, Passenger will deal 25% increased damage to them for 4 seconds
When attacking enemies with 70% or more HP, Passenger will deal 28% increased damage to them for 4 seconds
In Reclamation Algorithm , allies take -100% damage from environmental effects ; Passenger gains ATK +60% and obtains 1 SP per second

When attacking enemies with more than 80% HP, Passenger will deal 20% increased damage to them for 3 seconds; in Reclamation Algorithm , 4 targets are chosen every 12s to be struck by lightning (clustered targets are more likely to be chosen), dealing 400% of Passenger's ATK as Arts damage to all units within range; strikes grant visibility within that range for 12s

When attacking enemies with more than 80% HP, Passenger will deal 20% increased damage to them for 3s; in Reclamation Algorithm , 5 targets are chosen every 10s to be struck by lightning (clustered targets are more likely to be chosen), dealing 500% of Passenger's ATK as Arts damage to all units within range; strikes grant visibility within that range for 12s and give friendly units hit 2 SP
